title: Use the backend's conversation system
description:
The backend defines endpoints to use for `Conversation` models.
They provide ways for creating, updating, deleting and listing conversation flows available for a given user. This app needs to remain dumb and rely on the backend for storing and control over the conversations.

All the information about the backend endpoints is both in the `swagger.json` as well as the generated `src/generated/backend/services/CheckInsService.ts` and the models `src/generated/backend/models/CheckInDto.ts` , `src/generated/backend/models/CreateCheckInDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/ListCheckInsResultDto.ts` and `src/generated/backend/models/UpdateCheckInDto.ts`
